Remote Sales Rep

tersoai

Países permitidosMéxico, LATAM
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)
Idioma requeridoEnglish (Native or fully fluent)
ExperienciaProficient in outreach and partnership development
Salario5% to 10% uncapped commission on $10k+ deals
HorarioPart-time / Flexible

Fecha de publicación2026-11-25 (Límite: 2026-12-25)

Descripción del puesto

Growth and Deployment Strategist role for Terso AI, sourcing SME clients and closing custom software, automation, and AI agent projects with uncapped commissions.

Funciones principales

  • Attend networking events (8-10 hours/month) and contact warm leads and professional networks.
  • Run LinkedIn outreach (1-2 hours/week), occasional LinkedIn posts, and email outreach.
  • Help build local partnerships with SMBs and SMEs.
  • Optionally scope technical project requirements, join client calls, and close deals.

Requisitos

  • Native or fully fluent English.
  • Proficiency in email outreach, LinkedIn outreach, and partnership development.
  • Beginner-level sales closing skills; technical scoping skills preferred for Deployment track.

Beneficios

  • Uncapped commissions: 5% for sourcing, 5% for closing, or 10% for both on $10k+ deals.
  • 100% remote part-time schedule.
  • Direct collaboration via Slack with a team from Ivy League and top universities.
